_note: MMDetection's CocoMetric reports per-class mAP (IoU 0.5:0.95) and AP50 but not precision/recall in the same form as Ultralytics; precision/recall left null here rather than fabricated. AP50 values above are the 'mAP_50' column from the classwise CocoMetric table. Five classes (cell, cell-multi, module, offline-module, soiling) scored exactly 0.0 across every IoU threshold and area size, indicating zero detections for those categories after only 12 training epochs -- see docs/MODEL_COMPARISON note.
